info.name: Devialet IP Control Sound Control API

params.name: systemId
params.description: System identifier. The only value supported today is `current`, which refers to the system of the dispatcher.

items.docs: Query the current volume of the designated system, in percent (0-100). All devices in the same system share the same volume. Minimal firmware: DOS >= 2.14.

params.name: systemId
params.description: System identifier. The only value supported today is `current`, which refers to the system of the dispatcher.

items.docs: Set the current volume of the designated system, in percent (0-100). All volume commands unmute the current source but do not change `playingState`. Values outside the range report the `InvalidValue` error code. Minimal firmware: DOS >= 2.14.

info.name: Increase the system volume by one step

params.name: systemId
params.description: System identifier. The only value supported today is `current`, which refers to the system of the dispatcher.

items.docs: Increase the volume of the designated system by one non-configurable step of 5% of the volume range. If the current volume is closer to 100% than the step, it is set to 100%; if it is already 100% the request still succeeds. Minimal firmware: DOS >= 2.14.

info.name: Decrease the system volume by one step

params.name: systemId
params.description: System identifier. The only value supported today is `current`, which refers to the system of the dispatcher.

items.docs: Decrease the volume of the designated system by one non-configurable step of 5% of the volume range. If the current volume is closer to 0% than the step, it is set to 0%; if it is already 0% the request still succeeds. Minimal firmware: DOS >= 2.14.
